concept: An oud and fragrance house; a scent-layering builder and shop.

shots.title: Campaign hero
shots.prompt: Campaign photograph: the bottle on black stone with smoke curling from smouldering oud chips, featuring a faceted crystal perfume bottle with a heavy gold cap of original design. Editorial, cinematic light, space for a headline. Original design, no logos. Overall look: dark luxury still-life photography, smoke, warm rim light, 85mm; colour palette of oud brown, amber, black, gold. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
